dependencyGate.transitiveGate: T06 canonical contracts/DTO and migration/test harness foundations must be accepted before implementation or behavior testing.
dependencyGate.beforeGate: Only this synthetic fixture plan is prepared. Do not implement T16, connect PostgreSQL/services, run tests/builds, or claim database/RLS/CAS acceptance before dependencies are accepted.

harnessBoundary.syntheticInputs: Use ephemeral synthetic identities labelled A/B, WA/WB, D1/D2. Labels are symbolic. Ciphertext-looking bytes are opaque storage canaries only, not valid AEAD, crypto vectors, or T15 evidence.
plannedHarnesses: After T14/T15 gates, use disposable PostgreSQL with separate migration owner, trusted auth adapter, and non-owner NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS business/worker roles.

Use recording HTTP/session/device adapters, transaction barriers, controllable synthetic clock, and actual pool capped from limits.v1.json. Mocks cannot prove RLS, FK, rollback, locking, EXPLAIN, or DB acceptance.
Use T06-frozen canonical request/response encoding and strict DTOs before exact hash/UTF-8 boundary assertions.
forbidden: Production/shared PostgreSQL or cloud services, live accounts/devices/workspaces, real credentials/user data, or user-controlled clipboard/input.
Service-role/BYPASSRLS shortcut, table-owner application role, mock-only RLS pass, or static checks reported as DB behavior acceptance.
Creating real encryption vectors, valid AEAD ciphertext, or key material.
Changing limits, lock order, epoch, receipts/idempotency, RLS, or protocol errors to make fixtures pass.
Editing shared fixtures/contracts/migrations or running tests/builds/migrations/PostgreSQL/services during preflight.

syntheticActors.note: A/B own separate personal workspaces; D1/D2 are synthetic devices of A. Canary bytes are never claimed decryptable or cryptographically valid.

cases.setup: Seed WA/A and WB/B with synthetic entity/version/attachment metadata; D1 is authorized only for A/WA.
cases.action: Use A+D1 against WB and WB attachment; mismatch route/body wid both ways; run WA control.
assert: Cross-tenant responses are non-disclosing 404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND; no signed URL/body metadata/global-hash leak.
Path/body wid mismatch has zero writes, receipt, ledger delta, or URL; request fields cannot change auth-derived userId.
Inspect PostgreSQL rows/effects; mocks alone do not pass.

cases.setup: Install planned migration with distinct migration owner, trusted auth adapter, business API and worker roles.
cases.action: Inspect roles/policies; scoped and no-scope reads/inserts, including WITH CHECK violation.
assert: Business/worker are NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS and not protected-table owners; every business table has ENABLE/FORCE RLS.
USING/WITH CHECK scope reads zero unauthorized rows and rejects unauthorized inserts; no elevated bypass.
cn.user_id comes from trusted auth mapping, not request input.

cases.setup: Prepare active D1 lease, WA epoch and create op with opId/exact T06 canonical bytes; payload is opaque non-crypto canary.
cases.action: Commit, drop HTTP response, retry exact bytes, then retry same opId with one canonical field changed.
assert: Exact replay returns original result/seq; one version/change/event/outbox/seq only; receipt and mutation commit atomically.
Changed hash returns 409 IDEMPOTENCY_MISMATCH with zero new writes and no fresh opId; only committed ops are reported committed.

cases.setup: WA saved entity at r; D1/D2 prepare distinct ops at baseRevision r.
cases.action: Release pushes concurrently; inspect entity, versions, receipts and retained drafts.
assert: Exactly one commits r+1; other gets terminal 409 REVISION_CONFLICT with currentRevision/currentHeadVersionId/currentSeq.
Losing draft remains; server does not overwrite head/copy ciphertext; exact retry returns stable conflict receipt.

cases.setup: Prepare independent remote-delete/offline-update and remote-update/stale-delete histories.
cases.action: Commit delete then deliver old update; commit update then deliver stale delete; retry and attempt old ID reuse.
assert: Update after delete returns ITEM_DELETED without reviving ID; stale delete returns REVISION_CONFLICT and cannot silently advance base revision.
Deleted/retired ID is never reused; exact delete replay returns receipt, distinct second delete returns ITEM_DELETED.

cases.setup: Create synthetic collection, saved target, relation, independent revisions and immutable old version.
cases.action: Race relation/body edits; unpin/repin with new relation ID; try old-version mutation and old relation ID reuse.
assert: Relation/body revisions are independent; repin gets new ID and active relation unique key holds.
Old versions are immutable; edit creates CAS version; deleting collection/target does not show active relation or delete saved target.

cases.setup: Two valid WA operations; hold first after workspace lock/sequence allocation, then commit after delay or rollback while second waits.
cases.action: Run commit and rollback variants; inspect log, workspace.last_seq, receipts and pull.
assert: Seq increments last_seq under workspace row lock in the same transaction; no nextval substitute.
No later commit has lower seq; rollback leaves no visible uncommitted seq/log/receipt/version; pull cannot skip committed lower seq.

cases.setup: Read limits 50 items/131072 bytes; seed >50 changes and a separate dataset that reaches byte cap first.
cases.action: Fetch fixed cursor; interrupt before client cursor commit; refetch and apply page+cursor atomically.
assert: Each page obeys item and exact UTF-8 byte caps using T06 serializer; toSeq ends at final emitted row, only empty remainder may advance to upper.
Same cursor replay is stable; seq keyset, not OFFSET; no skipped/unreturned change and no large body inline.

cases.setup: Seed changes through H; first pull freezes upperSeq=H; concurrent push commits H+1 before next page.
cases.action: Continue old traversal then start new pull.
assert: Old traversal retains H and afterSeq<seq<=H ordering; H+1 appears only in next traversal.
Each short read is consistent; no live-head fallback, OFFSET, or connection held between page requests.

cases.setup: Seed active appliedSeq q, WA lastSeq L, snapshot_required and clearly expired device; seed synthetic ready snapshot metadata only.
cases.action: Try same-epoch advance/regression/>L, wrong epoch, ordinary ACK while snapshot_required, valid and below-H bootstrap.
assert: ACK monotonic same-epoch and <=lastSeq; invalid ACK has no effect; ACK represents committed local page transaction.
snapshot_required needs matching device/workspace/epoch/snapshot/H and appliedSeq>=H bootstrap; expired lease cannot push via seenSeq or blindly replay outbox.

cases.setup: Seed WA/WB entities/keys/versions; prepare cross-wid refs, mismatched keyVersion/kid and invalid head/trash pointers.
cases.action: Attempt invalid scoped writes and valid active-delete-retire transition.
assert: Composite FKs reject cross-workspace combinations; (wid,keyVersion,kid) and deferred (wid,eid,versionId) pointers match as a tuple.
Active/deleted/trash/retired checks hold; core version/log/receipt/ledger/attachment rows are not broad-cascade-deleted.

cases.setup: Seed nonnegative ledger and receipt/log; prepare duplicate (wid,source,phase), (wid,opId), and seq.
cases.action: Commit/replay event path; try negative counters, same-wid duplicates and same seq in WB.
assert: One mutation produces one idempotent usage event; counters stay nonnegative; scoped unique constraints reject duplicates.
Same seq in WB is allowed; a constraint failure rolls back version/seq/receipt/ledger/outbox together.

cases.setup: Use Decimal strings 0, 1, 2^53-1, 2^53, signed BIGINT max/max+1 and invalid syntax per field.
cases.action: Round-trip epoch/seq/revision/appliedSeq/bytes/conflict details/limitBytes through DTO, BIGINT and client parse.
assert: Values above 2^53 retain digits without Number rounding; invalid or >BIGINT returns 400 INVALID_DECIMAL/INVALID_DTO with zero mutation.
Respect field-specific positive/nonnegative constraints; no crypto vector.

cases.setup: Read limits 50 operations/1048576 UTF-8 bytes; use multibyte synthetic fields and frozen T06 serializer.
cases.action: Submit at count/byte boundary, 51 operations, byte cap and cap+1.
assert: Both limits derive from sole config; over limit returns 413 REQUEST_TOO_LARGE and zero writes/receipts/seq/version/ledger changes.
At-limit batch handles each op independently with per-op receipts; no batch-wide atomicity promise.

cases.setup: Read cap=10; use actual pool, WA/A and WB/B, plus failure after setting local scope.
cases.action: Exceed request concurrency, force rollback, reuse physical connections across A/B/no-scope.
assert: At most 10 DB connections per process; frontend concurrency does not expand pool; scope never leaks on commit/rollback/reuse.
Validate session/device and establish local scope/timeouts before protected queries/URLs/ledger; mock pool insufficient.

cases.setup: D1/D2 share WA; WB control; read 600 ops/min and 90-day receipt retention/offline lease.
cases.action: Commit 600 WA unique ops across devices; try 601st new op, exact replay and WB op.
assert: Limit is workspace-wide; 601st returns 429 RATE_LIMITED+Retry-After with no mutation; exact receipt replay consumes no new slot.
WB budget independent; receipt retention not shorter than active lease; missing post-expiry receipt does not prove failure.

cases.setup: Read 2000ms statement/250ms lock limits; one session holds WA lock while another request waits.
cases.action: Measure blocked request and over-budget statement, then inspect fresh-transaction state.
assert: Transaction-local limits cannot be lengthened by request; errors rollback before pool return and leave no partial effects.
Timeout is retryable DB_BUSY/STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE as applicable; EXPLAIN/perf timing remain separate NOT_RUN gates.

cases.setup: Prepare invalid DTO/Decimal, unauthorized object, CAS, idem, epoch/cursor/lease, oversized batch, rate and DB failure.
cases.action: Capture status, ApiErrorV1, retryable, Retry-After, requestId and durable effects.
assert: Use frozen 400/404/409/413/429/503 mappings; only transient network/storage/rate errors are retryable; disclose no SQL/tenant existence/ciphertext/credentials.
Unspecified SQL constraint error details remain open, not invented.

cases.setup: One synthetic summary alone exceeds 131072 bytes after serializer freeze.
cases.action: Do not assert error/cursor/skip/retry behavior until policy is specified.
assert: Does not count toward acceptance until spec/contracts define policy.
toSeq never passes an unreturned change.

openQuestions.question: T06 must freeze canonical PushOperationV1 bytes/hash and JSON serializer before exact idempotency/byte boundaries execute.
openQuestions.impact: Independent encoders can disagree on request hash or UTF-8 size.

openQuestions.question: How does pull report a first summary that cannot fit alone within summaryPageBytes?
openQuestions.impact: No invented error/cursor/skip behavior; gated fixture remains OPEN_QUESTION.

openQuestions.question: Rate-window algorithm/boundaries and Retry-After representation are unspecified.
openQuestions.impact: Assert workspace scope/no-write/Retry-After presence only; do not assume fixed/sliding algorithm or exact duration.

openQuestions.question: Lease renewal duration and equality-at-expiry semantics are not fully specified.
openQuestions.impact: Test clearly active/expired only; do not infer grace period or renewal duration.

openQuestions.question: 90-day receipt/lease cleanup timing and calendar-day versus duration semantics are unspecified.
openQuestions.impact: Assert retention is not shorter than lease; avoid exact cleanup boundary.

openQuestions.question: Exact external errors for every SQL CHECK/FK/unique failure are not enumerated in §9.
openQuestions.impact: Assert reject/rollback/no leak and only frozen mappings.
